semiconductor_relevance: High — Nippon Sanso India is a leading manufacturer of electronics gases critical for semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Nippon Sanso India Private Limited, part of the Nippon Sanso Holdings Group, specializes in the production and supply of high-purity industrial gases for the semiconductor industry. Their products are essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes such as etching, deposition, and cleaning, ensuring a robust supply chain across Southeast Asia, Korea, Taiwan, and India.
capabilities: High-purity electronics gases for semiconductor fabrication
